description: This file contains unit tests for the Android CIBuildAPI, specifically testing artifact download functionality, URL building, error handling, and credential inclusion in HTTP requests.

methods.name: TestDownloadArtifact
methods.description: Tests successful downloading of an artifact and verifies content matches expected binary data.

methods.name: TestDownloadArtifactWithErrorResponse
methods.description: Tests handling of an error response when attempting to download an artifact.

methods.name: TestBuildDownloadArtifactSignedURL
methods.description: Validates the construction of signed URLs for artifact download, including URL escaping.

methods.name: TestCredentialsAddedToRequest
methods.description: Ensures that credentials are correctly added to the request headers when configured.

methods.name: TestEmptyCredentialsIgnored
methods.description: Ensures that empty credentials do not add an Authorization header.
